semantics: After public GANTrainer constructor only; no model/gradient/controller mutation.
Zero Adam first and second moments for every G/D group parameter; float32 scalar step on each parameter device.
No random draw, no global default-device switch, no accepted update.
Full caller and learner RNG/state witnesses required before/after helper; only declared optimizer state may change.
Diagnostic scope explicit; no claim this wrapper is part of released public API.

One allowlisted, source-hash-verified optional setup after GANTrainer in construct, used identically by CPU and CUDA construction; archive helper in complete source ZIP; require declaration diagnostic scope and RP1 source identity. Guard already empty native states and completed_steps0 before helper; validate zero states after. No general fallback or post-load repair.
